note: THE GOLDEN CASES. Every one is a real place that went wrong or right for a reason worth remembering. A matching rule that breaks any of these does not get to write answer keys (kpc_us_key.py checks on start-up) and must not be pushed (run python3 tests/run_match_tests.py first). Add a case whenever a wrong join or a wrong alert is found and fixed - with the story in 'why' - so it can never come back. Fable's review, Oct 22: 'keep a golden file of the known cases ... the next rule change will break something old otherwise; it is only a matter of which one.' batch 1b: piece_names = the rule 18 piece test alone (kpc_key_rules.piece_ok), for names that join by another path (alias, a person, Recreation.gov) but must never be refused by the piece test.
